description: Get a conversation and up to 100 of its messages, oldest first. When `pagination.hasMore` is true, newer messages follow this page. Check `conversation.messaging` before sending, for example `{ "canSend": false, "reason": "hire_required" }`. If `canSend` is true, `reason` is null. Otherwise, `reason` explains why you cannot send. `system_channel`: a platform channel (Jobs for you or Updates) that never takes replies. `archived`: unarchive the conversation to send again. `not_selected`: the applicant was not selected for the bounty; the chat reopens if they are hired or moved back to pending. `hire_required`: on a free post, messaging opens when the poster hires the applicant; the applicant can still send their application first. If several reasons apply, you get the first in this list. Use `messaging` instead of the older `readOnly` field.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to retrieve
